title: llama.cpp
summary: llama.cpp is an open-source pure C/C++ implementation of LLaMA model inference that enables running large language models locally on consumer hardware. It achieves this through optimized inference and model quantization techniques.
problem_solved: Enables running large language models locally on consumer hardware without expensive cloud services or Python dependencies
why_valuable: Democratizes AI by making LLM inference possible on everyday hardware with minimal resource requirements and full privacy protection
